claim_text: Allstate's website and app have been disrupted since Monday morning
summary: TechCrunch reports that Allstate has had a tech outage since Monday morning, Nov 23, affecting both its website and mobile app. Newsweek says customers across the US reported being unable to use key online insurance services.
detail: Newsweek says reports of problems began Monday morning, according to the outage tracker Downdetector.
label: Reported
why_it_supports: TechCrunch says it confirmed the website and app were affected; Newsweek repeats that and adds Downdetector reports. Newsweek's confirmation rests on TechCrunch, so this stays Reported.

claim_text: Allstate's website told customers services were unavailable and it was working to restore access
summary: TechCrunch reports a message on Allstate's website saying services were unavailable to customers trying to log in and that the company was 'working to restore access as soon as possible'.
detail: Newsweek says the website displayed a message that a 'site update' was in progress.
label: Reported
why_it_supports: Both outlets describe the message on Allstate's site; we did not see it ourselves.

claim_text: Allstate's home page showed no outage notice when we read it
summary: When we read allstate.com on Nov 25 at about 5:25 PM ET, its home page showed its usual links for quotes, claims, bill payment and account login, and no notice about an outage or a site update.
detail: This does not show whether customers can sign in or use the app again. We did not sign in or test the app.
label: Confirmed
why_it_supports: Allstate's own home page as we read it.

claim_text: Allstate has not said what caused the outage
summary: TechCrunch says Allstate had not issued a formal statement about the disruption, its cause or when it may be resolved. Newsweek says Allstate had not publicly identified the cause as of Wednesday.
detail: TechCrunch says Allstate did not immediately return a request for comment. Newsweek says it emailed Allstate on Wednesday.
label: Not established
why_it_supports: Both outlets say no cause has been given.

claim_text: Newsweek says there is no public evidence the outage was a cyberattack
summary: Newsweek: 'There was no public evidence that the disruption resulted from a cyberattack.' It also says there is currently no evidence that customer information was compromised.
label: Reported
why_it_supports: One outlet's assessment; Allstate itself has said nothing about the cause.

claim_text: US administration officials said a recent wave of outages was caused by system upgrades, not cyberattacks
summary: TechCrunch reports that Trump administration officials said recent outages are not being caused by cyberattacks but by a recent set of upgrades to systems, many of which run on older technology.
detail: TechCrunch presents this as a comment on outages across several services, not on Allstate in particular. Newsweek says there is no evidence that the Allstate, Microsoft, FAA and TikTok incidents share a common cause.
label: Reported
why_it_supports: TechCrunch reports the officials' statement; it does not name Allstate as covered by it.

claim_text: Whether the website and app are fully back is not known
summary: Neither TechCrunch nor Newsweek reports that service was restored, and Newsweek says Allstate had given no timeline for full recovery. Allstate has published no statement saying it is back.
label: Not established
why_it_supports: No source says service is restored.
